author: EmuCore - Hub
title: I Beat 100 PS2 Games And Put Them In A Tier List
summary: PS2 or Die ranks one hundred games only after completing them, producing a two-and-a-half-hour catalogue survey whose value lies in finished-play perspective and unusually broad contact with famous, obscure and licensed releases.

blocks.text: The list ranges from Champions of Norrath, Silent Hill 2 and Espgaluda to Dora, Horsez, Little Britain, Shadow Hearts and lesser-discussed licensed titles. Requiring a completed playthrough changes the evidence compared with a ten-minute sampler: late difficulty, repetition, narrative payoff and mechanical growth can influence placement. The creator also frames this as the first hundred in a much larger catalogue, making the tier list a serialized reading diary rather than a claim that only canonical games deserve preservation.

Tier labels remain one player’s preferences, and “beat” can mean different completion criteria across arcade compilations, RPGs, sports titles and games with alternate endings. The timestamp list becomes incomplete after the early entries, while regional versions, difficulty settings and play dates are not documented. Affiliate and membership links support the channel but do not validate the rankings. Use the video to discover candidates and long-term impressions; consult genre specialists, accessibility information and independent technical sources before turning any position into a purchase or historical judgment.
